bullets.text: Windows 11 Insider Preview Build Released - New features and improvements are rolling out for Insiders in the Dev & Beta Channels.
Xbox Developer_Direct Returns - Celebrating Xbox's 25th anniversary with insights into upcoming games on January 22.
Enhanced Cyber Resilience Services - New proactive incident response services introduced to help organizations strengthen cybersecurity.
Phishing Attack Vector Insights - Microsoft reveals how complex routing is exploited for effective domain spoofing in phishing attacks.
Introducing Microsoft Defender Experts Suite - New expert-led services launched to enhance security against advanced cyberthreats.
NVIDIA Rubin Platform Integration - Microsoft’s strategic planning enables seamless deployment of NVIDIA's next-gen AI infrastructure.
Microsoft Acquires Osmos - Acquisition aims to enhance autonomous data engineering capabilities within Microsoft Fabric.
